title: Hearty Sour Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A sour and silky Kenyan stew featuring vanilla sugar, perfect for meal prep, made with low sodium ingredients and cooked to perfection using sous vide.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, vanilla sugar, and chicken broth.
Add the chicken, onion, garlic, and ginger to the bowl and toss to coat.
Seal the mixture in a sous vide bag and cook for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the bag from the water bath and let it cool.
Add the diced tomatoes to the bag and seal it again.
Return the bag to the water bath and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the bag from the water bath and serve the stew hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
